content: Fast Green FCF, also known by various names such as Food Green 3, FD&C Green No. 3, Green 1724, Solid Green FCF, and C.I. 42053, is a synthetic triarylmethane dye with a sea-green coloration. Its E number designation is E143. This dye is often recommended as a substitute for Light Green SF Yellowish in Masson's trichrome staining due to its more vivid coloration and greater resistance to fading. In histological applications, Fast Green FCF is utilized as a quantitative stain for histones under alkaline pH conditions following the acid extraction of DNA. Additionally, it serves as a protein stain in electrophoresis procedures. The dye exhibits an absorption maximum at a wavelength of 625 nm. Fast Green FCF is characterized by poor intestinal absorption when ingested. Its use as a food dye is prohibited in the European Union and several other countries. However, in regions where it is permitted, it may be used in products such as canned green peas, other vegetables, jellies, sauces, fish, desserts, and dry bakery mixes, with a maximum allowable concentration of 100 mg/kg. The dye is associated with risk phrases R36 (irritating to eyes), R37 (irritating to the respiratory system), and R38 (irritating to the skin).
